At the centre of this mandate is our responsibility to deliver high‑quality, trusted core economic statistics in a timely manner. This responsibility is non‑negotiable and remains the primary consideration in setting priorities and allocating resources. This includes responsible data stewardship and ongoing efforts to improve how diverse forms of economic activity are reflected in official statistics. In 2026/2027, this includes the successful delivery of the 2026 Census of Agriculture. This major operation requires secure collection, processing, and dissemination; systems stability and operational resilience; and sustained public and stakeholder confidence. Its delivery will require careful management of fiscal, workforce and operational resources, as well as close coordination across the agency. We will continue to streamline operations and identify opportunities to strengthen quality, coherence, and consistency in cross-field collaboration. We will also advance implementation of the 2025 System of National Accounts to ensure comprehensive data and international relevance. The delivery of core outputs that support legislation, monetary policy, fiscal transfers, and economic decision‑making will remain the field’s foremost priority. Programs will continue to adapt to emerging analytical and policy needs. This includes strengthening measurement of artificial intelligence and emerging technologies through TechStat; providing timely and relevant insights on Canada–U.S. economic relations, including trade, tourism, investment, and ownership; and supporting key policy domains such as defense, energy, critical minerals, environmental and ecosystem accounting, and northern economic development. Increased use of administrative and alternative data sources will continue to support these efforts while managing respondent burden. Where capacity constraints require trade-offs, they will be made explicitly and transparently, with resources focused on protecting mission critical programs and maintaining public trust in Canada’s economic statistics.
